title: Milestone: a content item goes from idea to published as one record
description:
Milestone: what done looks like.

Feature: One content item from idea to publication
  Scenario: A content item keeps its identity through the whole lifecycle
    Given a publication that names its content item "Story"
    When an editor creates a Story at the idea stage
    And the Story moves through research, reporting, editor selection, copywriting and publication
    Then it is the same record with the same id at every stage
    And no separate Article, Brief or Story record is created for it
    And research, reporting and copywriting work appears as work attached to that Story

  Scenario: The content item name is configurable per publication
    Given a publication that names its content item "Post"
    When an editor views the Newsroom, the Board or the operator CLI
    Then every label says "Post" for that item type
    And the stored data and code paths are identical to a publication that says "Story"

  Scenario: The Board shows one card per content item
    Given content items at different lifecycle stages
    When an editor opens the Board
    Then each content item appears once, in the column for its lifecycle stage

  Scenario: One idea becoming two pieces is an explicit split
    Given a content item whose research supports two separate pieces
    When an editor splits it
    Then two content items exist, each with its own lifecycle, linked by a derived_from relation
    And neither is a child "Article" of the other
